title: Don't Regenerate, Debug: A Domain-Specific Agent for Repairing Near-Miss Accelerator Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2608.02712v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Kernel generation for hardware accelerators such as GPUs and NPUs has become a proving ground for large language models (LLMs), and state-of-the-art systems raise correctness through pipelines that couple LLMs with agentic reinforcement learning and evolutionary search. Such pipelines generate, compile, and execute large numbers of candidate kernels, discarding most of them and forgoing the opportunity to distill failures into reusable knowledge. Many discarded candidates are near-miss operators that compile and run but fail numerical validation; each embodies genuine domain knowledge and a nontrivial investment in LLM inference, cross-compilation, and hardware execution. We argue for a paradigm shift: rather than regenerate, debug. Debugging is far more constrained than generating from scratch: the search space is small and feedback is dense. translated_title: 不要重新生成，而要调试：一个用于修复“差一点成功”加速器内核的领域专用智能体
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.02712v2 公告类型: replace-cross 摘要：面向GPU和NPU等硬件加速器的内核生成已成为大语言模型（LLM）的试金石，最先进的系统通过将LLM与智能体强化学习和进化搜索相结合的流水线来提升正确性。此类流水线会生成、编译并执行大量候选内核，却丢弃其中的大部分，错失了将失败提炼为可复用知识的机会。许多被丢弃的候选者是“差一点成功”的算子——它们能够编译和运行，但无法通过数值验证；每一个都蕴含着真实的领域知识，以及在LLM推理、交叉编译和硬件执行方面的可观投入。我们主张一次范式转变：与其重新生成，不如调试。调试比从头生成受到的约束多得多：搜索空间小，反馈密集。我们提出一个领域专用的调试智能体，以解决自动化内核……
tldr: 该论文提出“调试而非重新生成”的范式转变，设计了一个领域专用调试智能体，用于修复那些能够编译运行但未通过数值验证的“差一点成功”加速器内核，从而将原本被丢弃的失败候选转化为可复用的知识。
en_tdlr: The paper advocates a paradigm shift from regenerating to debugging, introducing a domain-specific debug agent that repairs near-miss accelerator kernels—those that compile and run but fail numerical validation—thereby turning discarded failed candidates into reusable knowledge.
